scope: Deterministic dependency-graph and execution-plan semantics only. This packet validates plan structure and readiness; it does not execute specialists, choose concurrency, retry operations, persist durable jobs, compile context, cache results, cancel/resume work or perform canonical admission.
dependency_rules: Every task_id is exact and unique.
Required and optional dependency IDs must name tasks in the same plan.
Self-dependencies and duplicate dependency IDs are forbidden.
The union of required and optional dependencies must form a directed acyclic graph.
All dependencies are explicit; the orchestrator may not invent hidden prerequisite edges during execution.
A downstream task is structurally ready only when all required dependencies are satisfied by later workflow execution state; optional dependencies never masquerade as required evidence.
Topological layers describe dependency independence only. They do not authorize parallel execution; concurrency authority belongs to Phase 2E and scheduling belongs to Phase 6.
A BOOK_ADMISSION_HANDOFF node, when present, must be a terminal sink and may not have downstream dependents.
No specialist service task may request CANONICAL_MANUSCRIPT_MUTATION authority.

A declared-but-noncallable required capability remains in the graph as DECLARED_BLOCKED_CAPABILITY and makes the plan not executable until a qualified callable interface is bound or the plan is truthfully superseded.
An AUTHORITY_WAIT node represents genuine external/human authority and cannot be converted to specialist execution merely to unblock a plan.

SPECIALIST_SERVICE_TASK: capability_id and required_authority_domain are required and must resolve through the exact Phase 2C capability registry.
Resolved capability must be callable and dispatch_class QUALIFIED_SERVICE_OPERATION.
DECLARED_BLOCKED_CAPABILITY: capability_id and required_authority_domain are required and must resolve through the exact Phase 2C capability registry.
Resolved capability must be non-callable and must not be BOOK.CANONICAL_MANUSCRIPT_ADMISSION.
The task remains visible and makes plan readiness blocked.
AUTHORITY_WAIT: capability_id and required_authority_domain must be null.
authority_wait_owner must be a non-empty external authority identifier such as AUTHOR.
This node cannot execute specialist business logic and makes plan readiness blocked until the external authority event is durably evidenced.
BOOK_ADMISSION_HANDOFF: The descriptor must resolve to SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK and canonical_write_authority true, but remains non-dispatchable in Phase 2D.
The handoff task must be a terminal sink and makes readiness blocked until the later admission-handoff packet authorizes the interface.

content_safety_rules: Plan state stores references and hashes only; raw manuscript, passage and candidate text fields are forbidden recursively.
Every input_ref_hashes value must be lowercase sha256 hex.
Context package refs are opaque references only until the Book Context Compiler contract is qualified.
Plan source identity is immutable and must equal the bound workflow source identity before execution is admitted.
Changed workflow source identity requires a new or superseding plan identity; it is not silently rebound.
admission_rules: Evaluator acceptance, Prose candidate generation, Story Bible checks, Research evidence or successful plan completion never imply canonical admission.
Only BOOK_ADMISSION_HANDOFF may point at BOOK.CANONICAL_MANUSCRIPT_ADMISSION, and the handoff itself does not mutate Book state in this packet.
A plan may terminate with no BOOK_ADMISSION_HANDOFF for LEVEL_0_NO_CHANGE or diagnostic-only workflows.
If a BOOK_ADMISSION_HANDOFF exists, all evidence tasks required by that specific plan must precede it through explicit required dependency edges.
replay_rules: Plan digest is deterministic over normalized plan content excluding plan_digest itself.
A changed task, dependency, source identity, input hash, context ref or authority requirement changes the plan digest.
Identical normalized inputs reproduce the same plan digest.
This deterministic identity does not grant retry authority for non-idempotent specialist operations.
